categories.main_business_segments: S.F. Holding Co., Ltd. operates primarily in integrated logistics services, including time-definite express, economy express, freight, cold chain and pharmaceutical logistics, intra-city on-demand delivery, international express, international cargo and freight forwarding, and supply chain services. The company provides end-to-end one-stop integrated logistics solutions domestically and internationally, serving various industries such as e-commerce, high-tech, automotive, industrial manufacturing, and pharmaceuticals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including AI algorithms, large-scale logistics decision-making models, large language models, IoT, automation, unmanned sorting centers, unmanned vehicles, robotic process automation (RPA), and automated warehouses. These technologies enhance operational efficiency, optimize route planning, improve sorting and delivery processes, and enable digitalized and intelligent supply chain management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include e-commerce platforms, high-tech manufacturers, automotive brands, industrial manufacturers, pharmaceutical companies, and consumer goods enterprises. The company serves both B2B and B2C markets, including strategic key accounts, mid-sized enterprises, and small and medium enterprises across multiple industries and geographic regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: S.F. Holding has extensive operations covering all prefecture-level and most county-level divisions in China, with a strong presence in Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, Southeast Asia (including Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia), Japan, Korea, Europe, and the Americas. It operates the largest air cargo fleet in Asia and maintains a global logistics network connecting Asia with the world.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the entire logistics supply chain, including upstream, midstream, and downstream activities. It provides comprehensive services from transportation (air, sea, rail, ground), warehousing, sorting, last-mile delivery, to integrated supply chain solutions, positioning itself as a fully integrated logistics service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating penetration into customers' supply chains across industries, expanding global reach with a focus on Asia, building a digitalized supply chain ecosystem through technological leadership, and promoting sustainable and green logistics. R&D focuses on AI-driven logistics decision-making models, large language models, automation, unmanned technologies, and digital supply chain solutions to enhance efficiency and customer experience.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through logistics and freight forwarding services, including express and freight delivery, supply chain and international business, and intra-city on-demand delivery. Additional revenue streams include sales of goods related to supply chain services, leasing services, and provision of technical services. The company also earns income from ancillary non-logistics businesses and investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: S.F. Holding is the largest integrated logistics service provider in China and Asia, and the fourth largest globally. It holds market leadership in multiple logistics sub-segments such as time-definite express, LTL freight, cold chain, intra-city on-demand delivery, and supply chain solutions. The company differentiates itself through a directly-operated, integrated, and independent third-party business model, advanced technology, and premium service quality.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of RMB 284.4 billion, a 10.1% year-on-year increase, with a profit attributable to owners of RMB 10.17 billion, up 23.5%. It maintains a strong asset base of RMB 213.8 billion and an equity attributable to owners of RMB 92.0 billion. The company has demonstrated steady growth in revenue, profit margins, and operational efficiency, supported by expanding business volumes and technological investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: S.F. Holding emphasizes premium, reliable, and time-definite logistics services, with a strong brand reputation synonymous with express delivery in China. Its unique value lies in comprehensive, customized logistics solutions powered by advanced technology, extensive network coverage, and a customer-centric approach. The company offers high-quality, efficient, and sustainable logistics services that enhance customer supply chain performance and foster long-term partnerships.
